The speed of light in water is v and the speed of light in air is 1.33v. What is true about the optical density of air and water and the existence of a critical angle when light passes from air to water?

Optical density

Critical angle
A. Optical density of air < Optical density of water Does not exist
B. Optical density of air < Optical density of water Exists
C. Optical density of air > Optical density of water Does not exist
D. Optical density of air > Optical density of water Exists
